facts.fact: Seventeen officers of Benin's data protection authority (APDP) were sworn in before the Court of First Instance of Cotonou on 14 September 2026 under Article 468(2) of the Digital Code, on the instruction of the APDP president.
La Nation, 5 September 2026, treats the Code du numérique, Article 379, as the framework that currently governs personal data processing in Benin, including employer access to work messaging.
Me Luciano Hounkponou, president of the Apdp-Bénin, spoke as panellist at the MTN Group Fintech Summit regulators' forum in Johannesburg, 1 to 3 September 2026.

The APDP's published 2025 report, as relayed by La Nation, gives 907 files examined and 793 validated (606 authorisations, 187 declarations), 782 cases handled by its control and litigation service, 64 inspection missions, 20 complaints treated and 75 compliance certificates issued.

The APDP's litigation session examined 14 major cases in 2025, leading to formal notices, recommendations and, in the gravest cases, financial penalties; 99 further formal-notice procedures were investigated.
The APDP, led by president Me Luciano Hounkponou, published its annual report for 2025 on its activity under the Digital Code.
